name: Wake lock
plain: Keeps the CPU or screen awake.
meaning: Prevents sleep and drains battery. Android flags apps that hold long wake locks in Android vitals.

android.store_policy: Play: Android vitals tracks excessive partial wake locks
android.note: Doze and App Standby ignore wake locks in some states.

ios.note: Screen wake only; no CPU wake lock.

limits.headline: Can keep your phone's processor awake on Android, or the screen on iPhone
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens during a download, a video, a workout or a call
can: Keep the screen on during a video or recipe on iPhone
Keep the processor running so a task can finish on Android
Be allowed at install without a prompt on Android
cannot: Keep the processor awake on iPhone; it only keeps the screen on
Always beat Doze and App Standby, which ignore wake locks in some states
Hold the phone awake after the task is over without draining the battery
limits.differs: Android has a CPU wake lock granted at install. iPhone can only keep the screen awake.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app keep the phone's brain or screen awake instead of letting it sleep.

marketing.name: Wake locks
marketing.pitch: Google tells developers to use wake locks sparingly and flags apps that hold them too long in Android vitals.

story.for_you: You see the screen stay on while you watch a video or follow a recipe. Quietly, an app can also keep the phone awake in your pocket, which drains the battery.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to keep playback, downloads and uploads from being cut off. Google watches wake lock time closely because a bad one is a top cause of battery complaints.

use_cases.example: A streaming app keeps the screen on during a movie so it does not dim.
A navigation app keeps the screen and brain awake on a road trip.
A run tracker keeps recording when the screen is off.
A game keeps the screen awake during a match so it does not lock.
A recipe or teleprompter app keeps the page lit.
A video call keeps both screen and processor awake during the call.
A developer uses the Android vitals dashboard to find which apps hold wake locks too long.

risks: A stuck wake lock can keep the phone warm
story.android_note: Granted at install. Doze and standby ignore wake locks in some states.
story.ios_note: iOS only lets apps keep the screen awake. There is no wake lock for the processor.
